test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rajpal borrowed a certain amount at 10% per annum simple interest for 1 (1)/(2) years. He gave the same amount as loan to a friend and charged compound interest (compounded semi-annually) at the same rate for the same period. In this way he earned Rs.305. Find the sum of the money.
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 1 (1)/(2)years

Rate = 10%

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × t × r)/100

CI = P(1 + (r/2)/100)²ⁿ - P [When CI calculating in semi annually]

**Calculation:**

Let Principal be Rs. 8000x

So SI = (8000x × 3 × 10)/200

⇒ 1200x

So CI = 8000x(1 + 10/200)³ - 8000x

⇒ 8000x × 9261/8000 - 8000x

⇒ 9261x - 8000x

⇒ 1261x

Difference = 1261x - 1200x = 61x

61x = 305

⇒ x = 5

So Principal = Rs. 40000

**∴ The sum of money is Rs. 40000** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**5% = 1/20Let P = 8000

8000 × 1/20 = 400

1st → 400

2nd → 400 + 20 [400 × 1/20]

3rd → 400 + 40 [800 × 1/20] + 1 [20 × 1/20]

So, difference = 20 + 40 + 1 = 61

Here 61 = 305

1 = 5

8000 = 40000
